data.one_liner: Web implementation of file_picker for selecting, streaming, and saving files in browsers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a browser file selection dialog, streams file contents in chunks, and supports saving files via the browser's save dialog. It integrates with the generic file_picker API as the web platform implementation.
use_when: You need file picking or saving functionality in a Flutter web app
You require streaming large files to avoid loading them fully into memory
avoid_when: Your app targets mobile or desktop only (use the main file_picker package)
You need advanced file system access beyond what browsers expose
strengths: Handles file selection, streaming, and saving on web
Fixes common edge cases like cancellation and empty files
weaknesses: Limited to browser capabilities, no native file system access
